942669:
**Steps:**
- You'll need to gather three items around the map to build the Thrustodyne M23:
   - [Water Pressure Gauge](#loc=942682)
      - First, head to Washington Ave. and grab the [Water Valve](#loc=942681). 
      - Then, head to Fuller's Liberty Lanes and place it into the [Pressure Gauge](#loc=942675) on the wall.
      - Hold interact on it until the bar fills up fully while defending against zombies.
      - Once full, the Water Pressure Gauge will pop out onto the floor.
   - [Electrical Wires](#loc=942685)
      - Acquire a Mangler Cannon and use it to blast open the doors to Radio House.
      - Interact with the trash piles until you come across the one containing the Electrical Wires.
   - [Handbrake](#loc=942683)
      - Head to the Cemetery and kill zombies until the Groundskeeper spawns.
      - Kill the Groundskeeper and pick up the [Toolshed Key](#loc=942679).
      - Head to the Groundskeeper's Yard and open the shed to acquire the Handbrake.
- Once all three are collected, head to the [Workbench](#loc=942202) in the Motor Lodge to build the Thrustodyne M23.
942670:
**Steps:**
- To build the L.T.G., you must first complete the [Thustodyne M23 Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=942669) and interact with the [Generator](#loc=942684) in the Dark Aether.
- Then, use the wonder weapon to pull in three different parts around the map:
   - [L.T.G. Part](#loc=942689)
   - [L.T.G. Part](#loc=942699)
   - [L.T.G. Part](#loc=942687)
- After all parts are collected, you can build the L.T.G. at the [Workbench](#loc=942253) on top of the Savings & Loan building.
942672:
**Steps:**
- First, complete both the [Thustodyne M23 Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=942669) and the [L.T.G. Easter Egg](#loc=942670).
- Head back to the [Generator](#loc=942684) and pick up the [Aether Canister](#loc=942711).
- Bring it to the [Dark Aether Field Generator](#loc=942244) and place it on one of the trap's generators.
- Head to the Cemetery and place the L.T.G. under the [Aether Cloud](#loc=942728) and defend it until an HVT spawns.
- Bring the HVT to the Dark Aether Field Generator and kill it inside the trap next to the canister.
- Bring the canister back to the Generator and place it inside, then grab the [Strauss Counter](#loc=942712).
- Head to the three projectors around the map and set them to a color depending on what the Strauss Counter has for the value (Green value = Red projector, Red value = Green projector, Yellow value = Yellow projector):
   - [Projector](#loc=942716)
   - [Projector](#loc=942714)
   - [Projector](#loc=942713)
- After all are set, head to East Main Street and grab the [Aether Canister](#loc=942717) there.
- Head to the [Dark Aether Field Generator](#loc=942193) and place it next to one of their generators.
- Take the L.T.G. and place it under the [Aether Cloud](#loc=942715) again, then defend it.
- Bring the HVT and kill it in the trap next to the canister.
- Finally, place it back into the generator to start the final boss fight.
